summary: Blue Moon Metals Inc., a TSXV/NASDAQ-listed critical-minerals explorer, filed a Form 6-K on October 30, 2026 disclosing mutual termination of its proposed acquisition of 33 tungsten and antimony projects in the western United States from a private, arm's-length vendor under a letter agreement dated August 10, 2026, first announced August 11, 2026. No break fee or termination payment is disclosed. The same release notes completion, effective October 23, 2026, of the company's continuance from British Columbia to Ontario, approved by shareholders at the July 30, 2026 annual and special meeting, with new articles and by-laws adopted. Watch for a replacement critical-minerals strategy and any disclosure of costs sunk into diligence; no arbitrage angle remains.
